label: Internal Fraud
description: Acts of fraud/misappropriation involving at least one internal party.

label: External Fraud
description: Acts of fraud by a third party.

label: Employment Practices & Workplace Safety
description: Acts inconsistent with employment, health or safety laws.

label: Clients, Products & Business Practices
description: Unintentional or negligent failure to meet a professional obligation to clients.

label: Damage to Physical Assets
description: Loss or damage to physical assets from disaster or other events.

label: Business Disruption & System Failures
description: Disruption of business or system failures.

label: Execution, Delivery & Process Management
description: Failed transaction processing or process management.

label: Governance & Culture
description: Board oversight, organizational structure, commitment to integrity.

label: Strategy & Objective-Setting
description: Risk appetite defined and aligned with strategy.

label: Performance
description: Identifying and assessing risks that affect performance.

label: Review & Revision
description: Assessing substantial change and reviewing risk/performance.

label: Information, Communication & Reporting
description: Leveraging information systems and communicating risk info.

label: Likelihood Scale
description: Rare, Unlikely, Possible, Likely, Almost Certain.

label: Impact Scale
description: Insignificant, Minor, Moderate, Major, Severe.

label: Existence
description: Assets, liabilities and equity interests exist.

label: Completeness
description: All transactions and balances that should be recorded have been recorded.

label: Accuracy
description: Amounts and other data have been recorded appropriately.

label: Valuation
description: Assets, liabilities and equity interests are included at appropriate amounts.

label: Rights & Obligations
description: The entity holds the rights to assets and owes the obligations recorded.

label: Presentation & Disclosure
description: Items are appropriately presented, described and disclosed.

label: Cut-off
description: Transactions have been recorded in the correct accounting period.
